findings.text: a figure taken from the published document keeps the age the document baked at composition time, so the group clock's age_seconds understates the reading's age at read time (probe at dfebd2b1: reported 20.0 s against a true 3020.0 s, observed_at correct) and a reader cannot tell a stale-but-freshly-composed figure from a live one; the new production wiring makes this reachable, and the fix site (reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py document_windows) is outside this node's write paths.

the _published_windows docstring still says the document is taken only when nothing was injected, so an explicit reading always wins, which the merge at reckon/budget.py:1472-1475 now contradicts by preferring a fresh published figure over the caller's recorded reading.
the crew preflight docstring still says the pace is read from the same recorded evidence, though a fresh published reading now paces a group, so the command's user-facing contract is stale.
the module docstring carries changelog prose (That reading used to be the whole answer), which the repository's comment rules ban and which rots as the code moves.

the recorded lint figures (base 6/4/20, head 6/4/20) do not reproduce under the repository's pinned ruff 0.16.4, which measures 4/2/18 in the base scratch tree and 4/2/18 at dfebd2b1, so the sentence's load-bearing claim holds but its recorded figures cannot be re-derived from the trees.
this test drives the changed surface through mcp._crew view=budget but was not among the 16 files the gate ran, so the zero-added-failures claim does not cover a caller that reaches the merge.

this test drives the preflight command while redirecting only RECKON_HOME, and the new wiring resolves the published document through the real HOME (~/public/reckon/paid-lanes.json, absent on this machine today), so with a document covering any declared backend the group entry gains a source key and the exact key-set assertion fails.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 9645fd62; seven paths, +507/-17, the per-backend merge and source map at reckon/budget.py:1452-1479, the two call-site edits, four tests, one figure, and the archive and plan updates, with the defects named below.
item_verdicts.done_when: the gate's 16-file selection is recorded in test_logs head.log (278 passed EXIT=0) and base.log (274 passed EXIT=0) with the four named cases in tests/test_preflight_reads_the_published_document.py, which I re-ran at the head (4 passed EXIT=0), but the head log names revision 9645fd62 with uncommitted changes present rather than the landed dfebd2b1 and its population omits importers that reach the surface (see findings).
item_verdicts.goal: read the goal in the reviewed manifest and the landed merge at reckon/budget.py:1452-1479 with both production callers at reckon/cli.py:965 and reckon/mcp.py:3512; each backend is paced from a fresh published reading and otherwise from the caller's recorded window, and the report names the source that spoke.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate, its two logs, its negative-control log and its measurement module, and measurement_module, measurement_cwd and negative_control_log all resolve on disk, but the head result is not tied to a resolvable revision and the recorded lint figures do not reproduce (see findings).
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the seven declared write paths in the manifest against the diff's seven changed paths; every changed path is inside the declared set, and the two deletions in docs/evidence/archive/the-local-lane-is-the-default-landed.html are only meta-line extensions, so the cumulative record is spliced rather than rewritten.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control in negative-control.log reinstates the dropped fallback and the absent-document case fails on it, while no case exercises the read-time age of a document-sourced figure.
justifications.evidence: test_logs head.log records revision 9645fd62 with uncommitted changes present rather than the landed head dfebd2b1, so the recorded pass is not re-derivable from the receipt.
justifications.fit: reckon/budget.py:1442 reuses the module's own document read path and constants, but tests/test_preflight_reads_the_published_document.py:6 carries changelog prose the repository's comment rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/budget.py:1472-1478 merges each backend from the document's fresh reading else the recorded window and records the source per backend, which is the goal's deliverable.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and docs/evidence/archive/the-local-lane-is-the-default-landed.html changed only its plan-commits and plan-artifacts meta lines before appending its section.
